&First = new()
Msg("default_child=" + Trim(Str(&First.Child.Amount)), status)

&Second = &First
&Second.Child.Amount = 9
Msg("alias_first=" + Trim(Str(&First.Child.Amount)), status)
Msg("alias_second=" + Trim(Str(&Second.Child.Amount)), status)
